title: The Magic Carpet
description: An ousted prince harnesses the power of a mystical floor covering to drive a villainous caliph from the throne.

title: A Raisin in the Sun
description: Proud members (Sidney Poitier, Claudia McNeil, Ruby Dee) of a Chicago family argue over a $10,000 insurance windfall.

title: Hook, Line and Sinker
description: A man (Jerry Lewis) runs up a fortune in bills after his doctor (Peter Lawford) tells him he has only months to live.

title: The Big Heat
description: When his investigation into a corrupt cop's suicide spawns a car bombing that takes the life of his wife, Police Sergeant Dave Bannion quits the force to pursue the case on his own.

title: Dr. Strangelove Or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
description: President Muffley and his advisers man the Pentagon war room, as planes with bombs head toward Moscow.

title: Easy Rider
description: Two free spirits (Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper) on chopped motorcycles clash with the Establishment and meet a boozy lawyer (Jack Nicholson) as they cross America.

title: You Can't Take It With You
description: An eccentric patriarch meets the stuffy parents of his granddaughter's fiancé.

title: The Whole Town's Talking
description: A bookkeeper (Edward G. Robinson) learns he looks just like a gangster whom police plan to shoot on sight.

title: Craig's Wife
description: A woman's (Rosalind Russell) obsession with neatness and material goods drives out her husband (John Boles), family and servants.

title: Theodora Goes Wild
description: A small-town New England author (Irene Dunne) meets her racy novel's urbane illustrator (Melvyn Douglas) in Manhattan.

title: Gidget Grows Up
description: Gidget goes to New York, becomes a U.N. guide and meets an older man.

title: It Should Happen to You
description: An executive (Peter Lawford) and a filmmaker (Jack Lemmon) woo a model (Judy Holliday) famous for having her name on a billboard.

title: The Wackiest Ship in the Army
description: A captain (Jack Lemmon) and his ensign (Ricky Nelson) take a sorry ship and crew on a World War II spy mission.

title: Twentieth Century
description: An actress (Carole Lombard) deserts the Broadway director (John Barrymore) who bolstered her career, then meets him on the Chicago-New York express.

title: Walk, Don't Run
description: A British businessman (Cary Grant) shares an apartment with a U.S. athlete (Jim Hutton) and a diplomat's fiancée (Samantha Eggar) during the Tokyo Olympics.

title: In Cold Blood
description: Two ex-convicts (Robert Blake, Scott Wilson) are tried for the savage killing of a farm family in 1959 Kansas.

title: The Big Heat
description: When his investigation into a corrupt cop's suicide spawns a car bombing that takes the life of his wife, Police Sergeant Dave Bannion quits the force to pursue the case on his own.

title: Easy Rider
description: Two free spirits (Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper) on chopped motorcycles clash with the Establishment and meet a boozy lawyer (Jack Nicholson) as they cross America.

title: The Harder They Fall
description: A fight promoter (Rod Steiger) hires a hard-luck sportswriter (Humphrey Bogart) to hype a simple Argentine boxer for the mob.

title: The Long Gray Line
description: On the eve of his retirement, an Irish immigrant looks back upon his lifetime of service to West Point military academy.

title: Three on a Couch
description: An artist tries to help his psychiatrist fiancée by posing as suitors for her lovesick patients.

title: The Howards of Virginia
description: Politics divide a Williamsburg couple (Cary Grant, Martha Scott) as events lead to the Revolutionary War.

title: Our Wife
description: A composer (Melvyn Douglas) goes on a cruise and meets a woman (Ruth Hussey) he likes more than his wife (Ellen Drew).

title: Gidget
description: A California girl called Gidget (Sandra Dee) spends summer with surf bums called Moondoggie (James Darren) and Kahuna (Cliff Robertson).

title: Autumn Leaves
description: A New England spinster (Joan Crawford) marries a younger man (Cliff Robertson) who has mental problems and another wife (Vera Miles).

title: The Mouse That Roared
description: The field marshal, prime minister and grand duchess (Peter Sellers) of Fenwick declare war on the United States.

title: The Fuller Brush Girl
description: A door-to-door saleswoman (Lucille Ball) and her boyfriend (Eddie Albert) flee from mobsters and the police after a murder mix-up.

title: Good Neighbor Sam
description: A San Francisco adman (Jack Lemmon) poses as his wife's friend's (Romy Schneider) husband so that she can inherit $15 million.

title: Paula
description: A boy left mute by a hit-and-run accident discovers his speech teacher (Loretta Young) was the driver.

title: The Collector
description: A British butterfly collector kidnaps an art student, Miranda Grey, and keeps her in his farmhouse cellar.

title: American Madness
description: An idealistic bank officer is taken to task by the board of directors when they learn of his unorthodox loan policies.

title: The Taming of the Shrew
description: Shakespeare's Petruchio weds Katharina on his own terms in Padua.

title: Scandal Sheet
description: When a New York tabloid editor (Broderick Crawford) accidentally kills his wife, his best reporters (Donna Reed, John Derek) figure it out.

title: Rusty Leads the Way
description: A boy (Ted Donaldson) and his dog try to help their new friend, a girl (Sharyn Moffett) struggling with her blindness.

title: The Trouble With Angels
description: A headstrong girl (Hayley Mills) and her best friend (June Harding) bedevil the mother superior (Rosalind Russell) of a convent school.

title: Holiday
description: A tomboy New York socialite (Katharine Hepburn) flirts with her stuffy sister's (Doris Nolan) down-to-earth fiancé (Cary Grant).

title: The Ambushers
description: A secret agent (Dean Martin) saves a flying-saucer prototype and its pilot (Janice Rule) in the third of four Matt Helm movies.

title: Eight Iron Men
description: GIs sit in a bombed-out house with a comrade trapped outside; then one (Bonar Colleano) does something.

title: Hook, Line and Sinker
description: A man (Jerry Lewis) runs up a fortune in bills after his doctor (Peter Lawford) tells him he has only months to live.

title: In Cold Blood
description: Two ex-convicts (Robert Blake, Scott Wilson) are tried for the savage killing of a farm family in 1959 Kansas.

title: Divorce American Style
description: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.

title: Fire Down Below
description: A woman (Rita Hayworth) without a passport divides West Indies smugglers (Robert Mitchum, Jack Lemmon), then a fire threatens to sink a freighter.
